headline_marked: YouTube [[picture-in-picture mode]] is broken on iPhone and Android
headline: YouTube picture-in-picture mode is broken on iPhone and Android
summary: Users are reporting that YouTube's picture-in-picture functionality is not working on both iOS and Android devices. The issue prevents videos from continuing to play in a small window when the app is closed.
details: YouTube is aware of a widespread issue affecting its picture-in-picture (PiP) mode on both Android and iPhone devices. Users have reported that the feature fails to activate when they attempt to close the app, interrupting their viewing experience.

This means that videos will stop playing entirely when a user navigates away from the YouTube app, rather than continuing to play in a small, floating window. This functionality is a key feature for many users who multitask on their devices.

The problem appears to be affecting a significant number of users across both major mobile operating systems. While YouTube has acknowledged the bug, there is currently no timeline provided for a fix.

headline_marked: Waymo [[robotaxi service resumes]] in San Francisco after hour-long pause
headline: Waymo robotaxi service resumes in San Francisco after hour-long pause
summary: The autonomous driving service was temporarily halted due to a city-wide power outage, impacting thousands of PG&E customers.
details: Waymo's robotaxi service in San Francisco experienced a temporary pause lasting approximately one hour. This disruption occurred during a significant power outage that affected around 7,000 PG&E customers in the city.

During the pause, Waymo informed customers that service was temporarily suspended and that freeway routes were unavailable. The company stated it was making "temporary adjustments" to its service while monitoring local conditions.

This incident is not the first time Waymo's operations have been affected by power outages or similar disruptions in San Francisco. Previous incidents include vehicles stalling during a blackout in December and traffic paralysis during a Fourth of July fireworks show.

In response to these recurring issues, San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie has called for stricter state regulations to better manage autonomous vehicle operations during major incidents, whether planned or unplanned.
